entries.description: Build script `build-entity-map-docx.py` references entity field `cluster` (e.g. line 497, 718) and bridge fields `name` + `reason` (lines 187, 294, 567). The canonical schema `_references/schemas/entity-map.json` declares `cluster_id` for entities and only `id`/`clusters_connected`/`connection_count` for bridges. Schema-conformant JSON output crashes the build script with KeyError on both fields. Also: `entity-vector-space.py` does not accept the `--map-file` flag documented in SKILL.md SOP step (Push to Drive > Generate vector-space chart) - script signature is `entity-vector-space.py {scope-folder-path}` with optional `--output` only.
entries.resolution: Worked around by patching JSON to include both fields (added `cluster` alias alongside `cluster_id`, and added `name` + `reason` to each bridge). Future fix: either (a) update the schema to require `name` + `reason` on bridges and rename `cluster_id` → `cluster` (or vice versa), OR (b) update the build script to read the schema-conformant field names. Recommend (a) - the script's field names are more readable and the bridge `reason` field is genuinely useful for downstream consumers. Also fix SKILL.md SOP to remove the bogus `--map-file` flag from the `entity-vector-space.py` invocation example.
